text.arabic_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُنَا وَمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ مِن شَىْءٍ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا تَكْذِبُونَ

words.gloss_range: completed collective saying that opens direct counter-speech
words.root_gloss_range: q-w-l ranges across saying, assertion, proposition, and speech-act language; the local Form I perfect reports a completed collective utterance
words.prose: {{ar:قَالُوا۟}} ({{tr:qālū}}) shifts the scene into the town's completed collective speech. The 3mp suffix carries the speakers inside the verb, and the q-w-l root makes the response a public proposition whose truth-value will be fought over. The ayah then unfolds as three asserted denials: identity reduction, denial of merciful sending, and a closing accusation. The same speech root also collides with the messengers' speech in 36:14, recurs through the town-dialogue sequence including 36:18, and later belongs to the surah's mercy arc (36:52; 36:58). Its qāf opening gives the counter-speech a hard polemical entry that fits the stop-heavy close on the lying accusation.

topics.headline: completed collective speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the town's rejection enters as a completed group utterance, with the collective speaker carried by the verb ending.
topics.reason: QAC marks a perfect 3mp speech verb and attachment resolves the hidden subject to the town people.

topics.headline: speech as contested proposition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the response is not noise or emotion only; it is a chain of truth-claims set against the messengers' claim.
topics.reason: The speech verb governs the whole quotation, and the CRITICAL semantic rows coherently read q-w-l as assertion or proposition.

topics.headline: speech root crosses the dispute boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same speech channel used for the messengers' declaration in 36:14 is now used for the town's counter-declaration.
topics.reason: The inter-ayah rows give concrete neighboring speech evidence, so the echo survives as a local boundary payoff.

topics.headline: opening verb frames the whole denial scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that human counter-speech controls the audible scene before any individual denial is parsed.
topics.reason: The clause headed by the speech verb governs the full quotation and launches the three-beat denial sequence.

topics.headline: hard speech opening within the mercy arc
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a sharp polemical opening that also belongs to repeated same-surah speech scenes and the later mercy-name turn (36:52; 36:58).
topics.reason: The recurrence and sound observations are local enough to preserve as secondary payoff, without turning sound into semantic proof.

words.gloss_range: negative particle opening the first restriction frame
words.prose: {{ar:مَآ}} ({{tr:mā}}) starts by negating identity rather than an action. With the later exception particle it becomes the first half of qaṣr, so the addressees are syntactically confined to mortality. Its long repeated form also prepares the paired negative launch at word 8, making social dismissal and theological denial sound like coordinated parts of one rejection.

topics.headline: identity negation becomes restriction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the town is not merely saying the messengers are human; it is denying every higher status before leaving only the human label.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment identify the particle as the first element of a negation-exception restriction over the nominal predicate.

topics.headline: repeated negative opening
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first two denial clauses begin with the same negative sound, linking identity denial with denial of sending.
topics.reason: The repeated surface particle and parallel clauses support an intra-ayah formal echo.

topics.headline: opening identity-reduction beat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first rhetorical move is reduction of the messengers' identity, before the argument moves to revelation and lying.
topics.reason: The first clause is syntactically a restricted nominal predication, so its rhetorical role as the first beat is locally licensed.

words.gloss_range: independent second-person plural pronoun as subject of the first restricted nominal clause
words.prose: {{ar:أَنتُمْ}} ({{tr:antum}}) fixes the accusation on the known messengers before the predicate appears. Because the pronoun is independent, the address is visible rather than hidden in verbal morphology. Its later repetition at word 14 makes the ayah's two restriction frames address the same people: first by reducing what they are, then by accusing what they do.

topics.headline: explicit addressee subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denial is aimed at specific messengers, not at an abstract idea about humanity.
topics.reason: QAC treats the pronoun as the nominal subject and resolves it to the messengers addressed in the scene.

topics.headline: independent visible address slot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the addressee slot is foregrounded before the reducing label is supplied.
topics.reason: The pronoun precedes the exception predicate and stands as an independent form.

topics.headline: address reversal and repeated pronoun frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same second-person relation turns from the messengers' address to the town in 36:14 into the town's accusation back at the messengers.
topics.reason: The boundary and repetition rows are supported by the repeated pronoun at word 14 and the dialogue reversal from 36:14.

words.gloss_range: exception particle completing the first identity restriction

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: restricted human predicate left by the first exception hinge

words.prose: {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}) is the hinge that turns negation into confinement. It leaves {{ar:بَشَرٌ}} ({{tr:basharun}}) as the only surviving predicate, so the town's grammar collapses messenger-status into one social category. Because the same hinge returns near the end, the ayah pairs restriction of being with restriction of doing.

topics.headline: first exception hinge confines identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that mortality is not offered as one description among others; the construction makes it the only allowed description.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the particle as completing qaṣr, and attachment marks the first clause as restricted predication.

topics.headline: exception and only-force together
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the particle both excludes alternatives and produces the only-force needed for the town's reduction.
topics.reason: The semantic row is consistent with the local negation-exception construction.

topics.headline: paired restriction enclosure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the two exception particles frame the ayah by confining first identity and then action.
topics.reason: The later matching particle at word 15 completes a parallel restriction frame, so the structural payoff survives.

words.gloss_range: indefinite human/mortal predicate inside the restriction frame
words.root_gloss_range: b-sh-r includes human being, visible skin/surface, direct contact, outer-skin removal, tidings, and visible beginnings; locally the human-being branch is selected, with skin and tidings pressures only as narrowed root-field color
words.prose: {{ar:بَشَرٌۭ}} ({{tr:basharun}}) supplies the restricted predicate: the messengers are reduced to generic mortal humanity. Its nominative, indefinite form makes the label broad and ordinary, while the b-sh-r root's skin-field lets the town's argument lean on visible embodiment. The good-news branch is only a narrowed irony: the local sense is not tidings, but the root field makes it striking that the news-bearers are dismissed as skin-bearing humans. The phrase also belongs to a recurring rejection formula (14:10; 23:33; 26:186).

topics.headline: restricted human predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that human mortality is the grammatical predicate left standing by the restriction frame.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment identify the word as the nominative predicate of the first qaṣr clause.

topics.headline: generic ordinary mortality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the town reduces the messengers to an ordinary indefinite human instance, not to a named honorable class.
topics.reason: The indefinite nominative predicate supports generic reduction in the restricted clause.

topics.headline: visible skin-root reduction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the corporeal edge of the objection: the messengers are treated as visibly embodied skin-creatures, while the local selected sense remains human being.
topics.reason: V4 distinguishes the human-being branch from skin/surface branches, so the root image is preserved as narrowed pressure, not as a replacement sense.

topics.headline: news-bearing root-field irony
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices an irony in the root field: those rejected as ordinary humans belong to a root family that also carries news-bearing language, while the local noun still means human.
topics.reason: The tidings branch is real in the root family but not the local lexical sense, so it survives only as narrowed irony.

topics.headline: recurring human-messenger rejection formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the phrase participates in a repeated Quranic objection to messengers through their humanity (14:10; 23:33; 26:186).
topics.reason: The rows provide concrete formula references and the local phrase matches the rejection pattern.

topics.headline: dismissive unit and boundary descent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the predicate flows into its qualifier as one dismissive unit and lowers the prior mission title into bodily sameness.
topics.reason: The phonetic and boundary observations are local and secondary, but they have a clear reader payoff.

words.gloss_range: speaker-bound likeness qualifier meaning like us or our equivalent
words.root_gloss_range: m-th-l ranges across likeness, equivalence, example, similitude, and parable; locally it selects likeness/equivalence with a first-person plural possessive suffix
words.prose: {{ar:مِّثْلُنَا}} ({{tr:mithlunā}}) makes the town itself the measure of normality. The suffix binds the comparison to the speakers, and the postposed qualifier seals the predicate into mortals like us. That likeness becomes a polemical test: if the messengers are our equivalent, the town treats their commission as impossible. The m-th-l root also brushes against the surah's parable frame from 36:13: the deniers intend equivalence, but their likeness claim becomes part of the example being shown. The nasal mīm and final -nā wrap the comparison in a sound pattern centered on the speakers' own us.

topics.headline: speaker-owned comparison standard
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the town uses itself as the benchmark for what counts as ordinary and therefore non-messenger-like.
topics.reason: Attachment identifies the suffix as possessive complement and QAC ties it to the speakers.

topics.headline: likeness qualifier seals reduction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that mortality is tightened into sameness with us, not left as a broad human category.
topics.reason: The word modifies or appositionally restates the human predicate, strengthening the first restriction frame.

topics.headline: form turns likeness into relation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the form is not abstract likeness but a possessed relation anchored to the town's collective self.
topics.reason: The attached suffix visibly changes the comparison into speaker-owned likeness.

topics.headline: likeness claim inside parable network
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices an irony: the town intends mere equivalence, while the same root field links their claim back to the parable/example frame of 36:13.
topics.reason: The local sense is likeness, not parable, so the exemplarity payoff is narrowed to same-root irony within the surah frame.

topics.headline: human-likeness rejection formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that human likeness functions as a polemical test: if the messengers are like us, the town treats their commission as impossible.
topics.reason: The b-sh-r and m-th-l pairing is locally present and formulaically meaningful.

topics.headline: nasal sound wraps the comparison
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word's sound encloses the speaker-bound comparison, reinforcing the us-centered cadence.
topics.reason: The sound observation is modest and local to the form.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction joining the first and second denial clauses
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps the first and second denials at the same syntactic rank. The town does not pause after reducing the messengers to ordinary humans; it adds a theological denial of sending-down as a co-level claim. Its attachment to the next negative particle makes the middle beat sound dependent on and cumulative with the first.

topics.headline: co-level denial coordination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that mortality reduction and revelation denial stand as coordinated claims, not as main point and aside.
topics.reason: Attachment marks the second clause as coordinated with the first.

topics.headline: bridge from personal attack to theology
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the argument's movement: because the messengers are treated as ordinary, the town also denies a divine sending event.
topics.reason: The conjunction joins the clauses additively and preserves both claims as jointly live.

topics.headline: recited fusion into second negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the conjunction leans directly into the next negative particle, making the second denial audibly attached to the first.
topics.reason: The phonetic payoff is local and does not overrule the syntactic coordination.

words.gloss_range: negative particle over the perfect sending-down verb

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: emphatic min phrase that makes the denied object scope absolute

words.prose: {{ar:مَآ}} ({{tr:mā}}) now negates an event rather than an identity. It turns the causative descent verb into a denial that the sending-down happened at all, then joins with {{ar:مِن شَىْءٍ}} ({{tr:min shayʾin}}) to make the object denial absolute. Repeating the same negative particle from word 2 lets the middle clause mirror the opening dismissal while standing at the center of the ayah's hostile frame.

topics.headline: negated completed sending event
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the town denies the occurrence of revelation, not merely its present availability.
topics.reason: QAC marks the particle as negating the perfect verb of sending-down.

topics.headline: same negator, new scope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same negative particle moves from social identity denial to theological event denial.
topics.reason: The repeated particle has different local scope in the first and second clauses.

topics.headline: negation reaches every object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the negative particle works with the later min phrase to exclude any possible sent-down thing.
topics.reason: Attachment identifies the governed phrase as the denied object under the negated verb.

topics.headline: central denial beat and formal symmetry
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the middle denial as the central proposition, formally linked to the first denial but followed by an abrupt final accusation.
topics.reason: The repeated particle opens the middle clause, while the final clause shifts to a different negator without conjunction.

words.gloss_range: negated Form IV causative sending-down with an emphatic object phrase
words.root_gloss_range: n-z-l ranges across descent, alighting, lodging, station, and caused sending-down; locally Form IV selects agentive causing-to-descend, with hospitality or alighting imagery only as narrowed root-field color
words.prose: {{ar:أَنزَلَ}} ({{tr:anzala}}) is the middle clause's pivot: the town denies a completed act of caused descent by the Merciful. Its Form IV shape makes the disputed event agentive, not a message falling by itself, and the later object phrase keeps the verb transitive while making the object totality emphatic. The n-z-l field keeps descent and alighting-arrival imagery behind the denied revelation, while local grammar keeps caused sending-down as the selected sense. The initial hamza gives the central denied verb a sharp onset. The descent field also reverses the surah's earlier affirmation of revelation in 36:5 and echoes broader denial formulas such as 6:91.

topics.headline: transitive verb with emphatic object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb still organizes agent and object even though the object is pulled into an emphatic min phrase.
topics.reason: Attachment identifies the divine subject and the min phrase as the denied object relation of the verb.

topics.headline: completed sending-down denied
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the town rejects the occurrence of the sending-down event, not only its current relevance.
topics.reason: The perfect verb sits under the preceding negative particle.

topics.headline: Form IV agentive descent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denied act is deliberate caused descent by an agent, not intransitive arrival.
topics.reason: QAC marks the verb as Form IV and ties its subject to the divine name.

topics.headline: descent and alighting image
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the spatial and arrival-image behind revelation descent, while the local form keeps caused sending-down as the selected sense.
topics.reason: The root field supports descent and alighting imagery, but local grammar selects Form IV caused descent rather than a separate hospitality sense.

topics.headline: surah descent affirmation inverted
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the town's denial contests the descent field already affirmed in the surah's opening theology (36:5).
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows provide concrete same-surah references, and the local verb is the negated member of that descent field.

topics.headline: sent-status answered by no sending-down
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the messengers' sent status from 36:14 is answered by denying any divine sending-down, a move also seen in revelation-denial formula 6:91.
topics.reason: The boundary and formula rows are concrete and do not override the local syntax.

topics.headline: sharp onset at the central denied verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices an abrupt sound entry at the verb that carries the clause's decisive denial.
topics.reason: The phonetic observation is local and modest.

words.gloss_range: definite divine mercy-name as subject of the denied sending verb
words.root_gloss_range: r-ḥ-m ranges across mercy, compassion, womb-related nurture, and divine mercy names; locally the definite divine name is selected, with womb/nurture image as narrowed semantic pressure
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ}} ({{tr:ar-raḥmānu}}) names the agent whose sending act the town denies, landing after the verb so the mercy-name falls inside the denial rather than before it. The definite proper name and nominative role make the claim sharper than no message happened: the Merciful sent nothing. Its intensive mercy-name force makes the denial ironic, because the communicative act of mercy is exactly what is rejected, and the r-ḥ-m root's nurture-pressure remains present without turning the name into a literal womb sense. The article's assimilation binds the name audibly as the denied subject. The same name sits inside a Surah 36 arc of mercy-name moments (36:11; 36:15; 36:23; 36:52), and it meets the thing-word again in a human-nullification pattern at 36:23.

topics.headline: definite divine subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denied sender is a specific divine name, not an unnamed source or vague power.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment identify the word as the definite nominative subject of the denied verb.

topics.headline: intensive mercy-name in denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the irony that the name saturated with mercy is invoked precisely to deny merciful communication.
topics.reason: The intensive mercy-name is locally the grammatical agent of the denied sending act.

topics.headline: womb-nurture root pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the nurturing-source pressure behind the mercy-name, while the local selected value remains the divine name rather than a literal womb sense.
topics.reason: The r-ḥ-m root evidence supports the association, but the proper noun constrains it to narrowed semantic color.

topics.headline: Surah 36 mercy-name arc
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this denial is one node in a same-surah mercy-name arc: feared, denied, invoked, and vindicated (36:11; 36:15; 36:23; 36:52).
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete same-surah references and the local word is the same divine name.

topics.headline: mercy-name meets thing-nullification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the mercy-name is linked with the thing-word in a local pattern of human nullification (36:15; 36:23).
topics.reason: The same-surah pair is concrete and relevant to the middle denial's object-nullifying phrase.

topics.headline: delayed subject with assimilated article
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the mercy-name lands after the denied verb, with its definiteness audibly bound into the name.
topics.reason: The subject follows the verb in the local clause and the article assimilation is a surface payoff.

words.gloss_range: preposition used after negation to govern and intensify the indefinite object

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: thing-word that receives total negated scope under min

words.prose: {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}) does double work. It visibly governs {{ar:شَىْءٍ}} ({{tr:shayʾin}}), but after negation it also universalizes the denial: not any thing at all. Placed between the denied descent verb and the thing-word, it turns no sending-down into no sent-down object whatsoever, answering the prior mission claim with total content-erasure.

topics.headline: governing and emphatic min
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the particle is grammatical and rhetorical at once: it governs the noun and intensifies the negation.
topics.reason: QAC marks min as an emphatic extra particle after negation while attachment marks its governance of the noun.

topics.headline: absolute object-zero scope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the town's denial leaves no minimal exception for revelation content.
topics.reason: The min plus indefinite noun construction after negation is locally identified as total negation.

topics.headline: pivot from verb to object erasure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the particle is the hinge between denying the sending act and erasing every possible sent object.
topics.reason: Its position between the verb and object licenses the structural payoff and the boundary row connects it to the prior sent-status claim.

words.gloss_range: indefinite thing-word governed by min while filling the denied object slot
words.root_gloss_range: sh-y-ʾ centers on thingness, entity, knowable/reportable matter, and links to willing in the root field; locally it means any thing/entity, with volition pressure narrowed

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: negated Form IV sending-down verb whose object slot this word fills
emphatic governing preposition that gives the noun genitive surface form

words.prose: {{ar:شَىْءٍ}} ({{tr:shayʾin}}) closes the middle denial on object scope rather than on the divine name or the verb. Although genitive after {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}), it still fills the denied object slot of {{ar:أَنزَلَ}} ({{tr:anzala}}). Its indefinite singular form under negation means not one thing, not any reportable entity of revelation. The root-field link to willing is narrowed: it adds pressure to entity-language and any willed entity of descent, while local grammar selects the broad thing-word. The phrase also echoes total revelation-denial formulas (6:91; 67:9), and the final hamza gives the object-zero claim a sharp stop.

topics.headline: genitive surface with object function
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that one word carries both the visible effect of min governance and the underlying role of denied object.
topics.reason: Attachment explicitly marks the noun as governed by min and as the object of the negated verb.

topics.headline: indefinite totality after negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the noun does not mean one unspecified thing; in this frame it excludes any possible thing.
topics.reason: The indefinite noun under negation with min is locally identified as maximally universal scope.

topics.headline: any knowable reportable entity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denial covers reportable content, not only a physical object.
topics.reason: The supplied lexical evidence for thingness coheres with the local broad object denial.

topics.headline: entity and will root pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a narrowed pressure between thingness and willing, while the local word still means any entity rather than an explicit act of will.
topics.reason: The root-field link is meaningful but must not replace the local indefinite object sense.

topics.headline: object node where descent and mercy meet
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denial lands not on the divine name or verb but on the total object-nullification created by the thing-word.
topics.reason: The word closes the central clause and is linked to both descent and mercy fields in the supplied evidence.

topics.headline: formulaic zero with sharp closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this total-zero phrase belongs to wider revelation-denial formulas (6:91; 67:9) and gives the middle beat a sharp closing stop.
topics.reason: The concrete references and final sound payoff are preserved as secondary evidence.

words.gloss_range: negative particle, not conditional, opening the final restriction frame

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: repeated negative particle whose pattern the final in varies

words.prose: {{ar:إِنْ}} ({{tr:in}}) is resolved by the following exception particle as negation, not condition. The final clause therefore does not ask if something happens; it confines the addressees to the closing accusation. The switch from repeated {{ar:مَآ}} ({{tr:mā}}) to {{ar:إِنْ}} ({{tr:in}}) keeps the restriction pattern but avoids mechanical repetition, moving the ayah into its last hostile beat. Against the messengers' emphatic assertion in 36:14, this particle helps turn assertion-pressure into explicit negative restriction.

topics.headline: negative, not conditional
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final clause is not hypothetical; it is another denial-restriction frame.
topics.reason: QAC notes the conditional/negative ambiguity and the local in...illā environment selects negation.

topics.headline: same restriction frame with a new negator
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices lexical variation inside structural parallelism: the negator changes while the only-force remains.
topics.reason: The final clause repeats qaṣr mechanics with a different negative particle.

topics.headline: boundary from assertion to denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the move from the messengers' emphatic assertion in 36:14 into the town's explicit negative restriction.
topics.reason: The boundary row is concrete enough to preserve as discourse pressure.

words.gloss_range: repeated independent second-person plural pronoun as subject of the final restriction
words.prose: {{ar:أَنتُمْ}} ({{tr:antum}}) returns as the explicit subject of the final restriction. The addressees are not allowed to drift; the same messengers reduced to mortals are now personally confined to lying. Repetition of the independent pronoun bookends the central revelation denial, making the theological claim sit inside direct second-person accusation.

topics.headline: same addressees reidentified
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the target of the final charge is the same messenger group from the first restriction.
topics.reason: Attachment resolves the pronoun to the same addressees, and QAC marks it as subject of the final nominal clause.

topics.headline: explicit target before final predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the accusation is made personal before the verb names the alleged action.
topics.reason: The pronoun precedes the exception and verbal predicate in the final qaṣr frame.

topics.headline: pronoun bookends the denial sequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the central denial of revelation is enclosed by two direct-address restriction frames.
topics.reason: The repeated independent pronoun at words 3 and 14 creates a visible address envelope around the middle clause.

words.gloss_range: exception particle completing the final action restriction
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}) completes the final qaṣr just as the earlier exception particle completed the first. Here the only remaining predicate is the closing lying verb, so the town restricts not just what the messengers are but what they do. Its penultimate position delays the charge until the last word, giving the accusation maximum landing force.

topics.headline: second exception confines action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the town confines the messengers' activity to lying, not merely their identity to mortality.
topics.reason: QAC marks the particle as completing the final restriction, with the following verb as restricted predicate.

topics.headline: mirror of the first exception hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that two different negators lead to the same exception hinge, pairing identity confinement with action confinement.
topics.reason: The first and second exception particles form matching qaṣr structures.

topics.headline: penultimate delay before closing charge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the particle withholds the only allowed predicate until the final word.
topics.reason: The word is penultimate and directly prepares the closing verb.

words.gloss_range: imperfect second-person plural Form II lying/falsifying verb as the final restricted predicate
words.root_gloss_range: k-dh-b ranges across lying, falsehood, denial, and declaring false; locally Form II imperfect makes a direct plural accusation of ongoing intensified falsification, with no explicit object
words.prose: {{ar:تَكْذِبُونَ}} ({{tr:takdhibūn}}) is the ayah's final landing word and the only predicate left by the last restriction frame. With no explicit object, the accusation becomes absolute: the messengers are characterized as lying, not only as wrong about one item. Its imperfect second-person plural form casts the charge as ongoing and personal, while Form II intensifies the falsehood/denial force. The k-dh-b root also turns the prior denial from 36:14 back onto the messengers and sets up the knowledge-response in 36:16.

topics.headline: objectless absolute accusation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the charge is not limited to one named object; it characterizes the messengers by lying itself.
topics.reason: The verb appears without an explicit object, and contextual valency supports absolute uses for this form.

topics.headline: ongoing second-person plural charge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the town frames lying as the messengers' continuing behavior and addresses the whole group directly.
topics.reason: QAC marks the verb as imperfect 2mp and attachment identifies the implicit subject as the addressed group.

topics.headline: Form II intensified falsification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the closing charge is stronger than simple error; the form carries active, intensified falsification.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the verb as Form II, and the sound/form row coheres with the intensified pattern.

topics.headline: denial root projected back onto messengers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the reversal: the town that has denied the messengers now uses the same k-dh-b field to accuse the messengers of falsehood (36:14; 36:15).
topics.reason: The root supports falsehood and denial senses, and the CRITICAL rows give the concrete prior-ayah link.

topics.headline: closing verdict answered next
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah closes with the town's total verdict, which 36:16 answers through divine knowledge and renewed sending assertion.
topics.reason: The verb is final, and the boundary rows connect it to the next ayah's knowledge response and the prior mission vocabulary.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The restrictive construction around بشر مثلنا makes shared visible humanity the stated reason to reject the envoys.
baseline_models.mechanism: The speakers reduce the envoys to exposed human appearance, convert resemblance into exhaustive identity, and then treat the absence of visible difference as proof that no transmission from above occurred.

activation_trace.role: The visible skin or surface supplies the perceptual level at which the envoys are classified.
General resemblance is assigned the stronger role of exhaustive equivalence.
Delivery from a higher source is what the surface-equivalence inference rules out.

changed_reading.before: You are humans resembling us.
changed_reading.after: Because nothing visibly distinguishes your human surface from ours, you cannot be carriers of anything delivered from beyond our level.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence وما أنزل الرحمن من شيء turns شيء under negation into an unrestricted cancellation of content.
baseline_models.mechanism: Descent is treated as delivery, while شيء names whatever can be known or reported; the partitive negation erases every possible delivered item before evidence about any particular item can be heard.

activation_trace.role: The branch contributes the delivery of a book, command, benefit, or affliction.
The maximally general knowable or reportable item makes the denial total.
Merciful beneficence is named as the alleged source whose giving is categorically denied.
Attributing falsehood to the envoys closes the denial by discrediting its only witnesses.

changed_reading.before: No unspecified thing was sent down.
changed_reading.after: Nothing whatsoever capable of being known, reported, or received can have come from the Merciful, so your report is false by definition.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قالوا opens an utterance whose final act is to assign كذب to the addressees.
baseline_models.mechanism: The speech does more than describe a fact: it manufactures a public status for the envoys. Because قول also carries the possibility of saying or attributing what did not occur, the charge is structurally capable of mirroring the fault it alleges.

activation_trace.role: An inward judgment is externalized as articulated public speech.
The branch keeps open the risk that speech attributes to another what was not so.
The predicate functions as an act of assigning the envoys to the category of liars.

changed_reading.before: They reported that the envoys were lying.
changed_reading.after: They publicly imposed the status of liar on the envoys, in an utterance that may itself be an unsupported attribution.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence assembles recitation, perfected judgment, a sent carrier, a straight course, and تنزيل from the Mighty-Merciful. Descent therefore presents as an ordered installation of guidance into a traversable human course, not merely a visible object falling from the sky.

activation_trace.role: The denied act can mean placing something in its fitting station or rank.
Recitation supplies the communicative content that the sequence identifies.
Perfection and secure ordering characterize the recited content.
The messenger branch supplies a commissioned carrier rather than a different species of being.
A path gives the installed communication a functional route.
Straightness contributes calibrated alignment rather than visible otherness.
تنزيل explicitly names the ordered placing that 36:15 denies.
Merciful beneficence joins the same source-root named in the denial.

structural_cues: 36:2-5 is an uninterrupted specification chain ending in تنزيل العزيز الرحيم before the rejection scene begins.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recitation, wisdom, messenger, path, straightness, and تنزيل in sequence; I infer that their sequence models descent as ordered placement into a route. A live alternative is that the sequence only identifies source and genre without redefining descent spatially.

changed_reading.before: No object has visibly descended from the Merciful.
changed_reading.after: No divinely ordered communication has been installed among us through a commissioned human carrier and a straight course.

context_deltas.mechanism: The verdict from visible human sameness is placed inside a sequence of constrained necks, barriers on both sides, covering, failed sight, and a contrasting response to the unseen. The accusation becomes a product of surface-bound access rather than a neutral assessment of all available reality.

activation_trace.role: The human surface is the only evidentiary layer the speakers acknowledge.
The lying verdict is the output whose perceptual conditions are re-evaluated.
A statement fixed as matching reality contrasts with the villagers' contrary status assignment.
A restraining collar supplies bodily fixation that prevents free reorientation.
Paired closures block access from both temporal-spatial directions.
A covering over the perceiver explains why only exposed surfaces register.
Failure of ocular sight marks the limit of the villagers' evidence.
Reality hidden from eyes supplies the contrasting domain to which a receptive hearer responds.

structural_cues: 36:7-11 moves from nonbelief through blocked orientation and sight to a hearer who responds to the Merciful in the unseen.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bodily and visual obstruction followed by receptivity to the unseen; I infer an epistemic arrow from occlusion to the surface-only verdict. The obstruction may alternatively portray a consequence of prior refusal rather than its cause.

changed_reading.before: Their shared visible humanity proves the envoys' report false.
changed_reading.after: The charge of falsehood reveals a perceiver confined to visible surfaces and unable or unwilling to register an unseen source.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus erases any descended شيء, while 36:12 places every شيء, including residual آثار, inside writing, enumeration, and a guiding record. The denied content is reclassified from an absent object to something knowable through its transmitted and remaining traces.

activation_trace.role: The general knowable or reportable item is placed under total negation.
Writing fixes what occurred into an authoritative determination.
A remaining mark makes an absent source inferable.
Total enclosure directly opposes the focus's totalizing exclusion.
The same general item-root is now included in exhaustive knowledge.
Enumeration makes every item and trace individually accountable.
The guiding record gathers the enumerated traces under a legible reference.

structural_cues: 36:12's كل شيء immediately precedes the parable whose villagers say من شيء in 36:15.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed quantifier frames and a trace-record mechanism; I infer that 36:12 pre-emptively destabilizes the erasure in 36:15. Alternatively, 36:12 may state divine knowledge generally without targeting the later denial's semantics.

changed_reading.before: There is no descended thing to inspect.
changed_reading.after: They erase the message from the class of knowable things even though transmitted speech and its آثار can enter an exhaustive record.

context_deltas.mechanism: Their claim of likeness occurs inside a scene explicitly struck as a likeness. The villagers use resemblance to close inquiry, but the composition uses their very response as a repeatable example; meanwhile multiple envoys are reinforced rather than made nonhuman.

activation_trace.role: Resemblance is the villagers' stated disqualifier.
The scene is deliberately rendered and displayed as an example.
The same root now marks a portable parable rather than identity between persons.
Commission and message persist across more than one human carrier.
Rejection is already enacted before the explicit liar charge in the focus.
Reinforcement increases corroboration without changing the envoys' species.
A third completes the reinforcing set that the villagers still dismiss.

structural_cues: 36:13 labels the coming scene a مَثَل before 36:15 supplies مِثْلُنَا; 36:14 multiplies and reinforces the envoys.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the enclosing parable label and the embedded resemblance claim; I infer a meta-level reversal in which their analogy becomes an example of recurrent rejection. The outer مَثَل need not lexically redefine inner مِثْلُنَا, so this remains a framing effect.

changed_reading.before: Resemblance to ordinary humans ends the case against messengerhood.
changed_reading.after: Their misuse of resemblance becomes the very repeatable example through which later hearers can recognize the rejection pattern.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah later repeats a true but bounded no-descent statement: no heavenly army was sent down, nor was one needed; a single cry produces the effect. This preserves the syntax while correcting its scope, separating absence of visible reinforcement from absence of divine action or commission.

activation_trace.role: The villagers deny every form of delivered intervention.
The unrestricted item-word makes their scope absolute.
The repeated descent-root is explicitly limited to a denied military delivery.
A mutually supporting host specifies what did not descend.
The sky supplies the literal upper origin expected for visible reinforcement.
A frightening cry replaces the imagined need for a descending host.
Singularity emphasizes the minimal means sufficient for the result.
Life and motion fall still without a visible army's arrival.

structural_cues: 36:28 closely echoes وما أنزلنا ... من ... من السماء, then 36:29 supplies a non-descending single event.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a later bounded negation and its sufficient alternative means; I infer that it exposes the focus's invalid expansion from no visible army-like descent to no communication at all. The later statement concerns punishment, so the correction is analogical rather than a direct dialogue reply.

changed_reading.before: If no extraordinary thing visibly descends, the Merciful has sent nothing.
changed_reading.after: They confuse the absence of a visible heavenly force with the absence of commission, although divine action need not arrive as descending spectacle.

context_deltas.mechanism: The moon is measured into منازل and all bodies move in an orbit without collision. The descent-root thus participates in calibrated stations and recurrent traversal, strengthening a reading of revelation as measured placement and sequencing rather than crude vertical transport.

activation_trace.role: The focus's denied descent can carry placement into a proper station.
Deliberate measurement supplies the ordering principle for the stations.
منازل realizes the same root as assigned locations in a measured course.
Return after departure makes stationing cyclical rather than a one-time fall.
The celestial course holds distinct bodies in ordered motion.
Flowing movement connects the stations into a functioning sequence.

structural_cues: 36:38-40 repeatedly couples determination, station, non-overtaking, orbit, and motion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured celestial stations under the descent-root; I infer a formal analogy to measured revelation. The live alternative is that منازل is an independent astronomical derivative with no intended bearing on 36:15's أنزل.

changed_reading.before: Descent would have to be a conspicuous object crossing vertically into the village.
changed_reading.after: Descent may be the measured placing of communication into appointed human, temporal, and linguistic stations.

context_deltas.mechanism: The carried descendants in a loaded vessel are followed by created things من مثله that people ride; rescue from drowning is then named mercy. In this transport system, likeness does not cancel function: matching form makes a carrier usable by those it carries.

activation_trace.role: The villagers use same-kind resemblance to disqualify the carriers.
Visible bearing supplies the carrier function.
The vessel is a medium that moves its passengers through a hostile element.
Full loading makes carriage, not visual difference, the decisive property.
Likeness explicitly belongs to what is created for riding.
Riding realizes the useful relation enabled by the like-made carrier.
Divine willing controls whether the transport relation continues.
Rescue defines the functional outcome a carrier or helper must achieve.
Mercy names the preserving relation realized through the transport sequence.

structural_cues: 36:41-44 runs continuously from carrying, through created likeness and riding, to danger, rescue, and mercy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a like-made transport medium that carries and a mercy that preserves; I infer a functional analogy in which same-kind humanity fits a messenger to carry speech among humans. The live alternative is that مثله refers only to conveyances and bears no social analogy to envoys.

changed_reading.before: A carrier like its recipients cannot bear a message from beyond them.
changed_reading.after: Likeness may be what fits a human carrier to convey mercy intelligibly among humans, just as a usable conveyance is made in a fitting likeness.

context_deltas.mechanism: In 36:47 the disbelievers invoke divine will to refuse human feeding: if God wished, He would feed directly. This repeats the focus's category error in another domain, treating divine agency and human mediation as mutually exclusive when provision can pass through commanded human expenditure.

activation_trace.role: Ordinary humanity is made incompatible with divine commissioning.
The speakers demand divine delivery without accepting a human delivery channel.
Human expenditure is the commanded mediating action.
The provision is already characterized as divine allotment before humans pass it on.
Feeding another is the concrete human act through which provision would reach its recipient.
Appeal to divine willing is used to cancel responsibility for mediated action.
The second exclusive verdict displays the same self-sealing argumentative form as 36:15.

structural_cues: 36:47 repeats the formula إن أنتم إلا and embeds a direct-versus-mediated divine agency argument.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divinely allotted provision, commanded expenditure, and refusal based on what God would do directly; I infer that this exposes the same anti-mediation logic as 36:15. The alternative is that 36:47 critiques stinginess alone, without reflecting on messenger mediation.

changed_reading.before: A divine sender would bypass ordinary humans, so human envoys disprove divine sending.
changed_reading.after: They falsely oppose divine agency to human mediation, just as they later deny that God's provision can reach someone through human hands.

context_deltas.mechanism: At awakening, a later human قول recognizes an event, the Merciful's promise, and the messengers' truth. Truth and falsehood cease to be competing labels in the village and become temporally verified relations between prior speech and realized event.

activation_trace.role: The envoys are assigned falsehood before the promised event is available.
A later articulated response revises the earlier human verdict.
The realized awakening supplies the event against which prior claims are tested.
A promise opens expectation toward a future fulfillment rather than immediate visible proof.
The same Merciful source denied in 36:15 is identified as promisor.
Fulfillment of word in event establishes the messengers' truth.
The commissioned speakers are explicitly reclassified as truthful.

structural_cues: 36:48 asks when the promise will occur if the envoys are truthful; 36:49-52 moves through the event to recognition of promise and truth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an earlier liar verdict and a later event-linked truth verdict with the same Merciful source; I infer a temporal adjudication of 36:15. The later speakers need not be numerically identical to the villagers, so the reversal is surah-wide rather than biographical.

changed_reading.before: The envoys are liars because their claim lacks present visible realization.
changed_reading.after: Their speech is a promise whose truth-relation becomes manifest when the event arrives; present delay cannot by itself establish lying.

context_deltas.mechanism: 36:58 presents peace itself as a قول from a merciful Lord. A sourced speech-act can therefore be the form in which mercy reaches recipients, weakening the assumption that only a separately visible object could count as something from the Merciful.

activation_trace.role: Human articulated speech frames the denial.
Mercy is the source-domain from which the villagers deny any arrival.
Freedom from harm is the beneficial content realized by the speech.
An articulated utterance is itself the explicitly sourced medium.
Lordship supplies authoritative provenance for the utterance.
Merciful beneficence is expressed as speech reaching its hearers.

structural_cues: The compact nominal line in 36:58 directly joins peace, قول, source, lordship, and mercy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a beneficial قول explicitly from a merciful Lord; I infer that communicative provenance can satisfy the focus's denied from-Mercy relation. Alternatively, this may describe a direct paradisal reward rather than model mediated revelation.

changed_reading.before: Nothing from the Merciful exists unless a distinct object visibly descends.
changed_reading.after: A sourced saying can itself be the arrival and enactment of mercy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus trusts mouths to assign falsehood while reducing the envoys to human bodies; 36:65 seals mouths and makes hands speak and feet testify to embodied acquisition. The human body is not merely a surface that limits truth but can become a distributed evidentiary medium.

activation_trace.role: Mouth-like articulated speech currently controls the public verdict.
The body is initially reduced to its ordinary visible surface.
A securing seal disables the organ that issued unsupported verdicts.
The mouth's ordinary opening into speech is explicitly closed.
Intelligible speech shifts from mouth to hand.
The hand bears the acquired acts that its new speech discloses.
Testimony supplies evidence grounded in knowledge rather than accusation.
Feet become independent bodily witnesses.
What was actually acquired supplies the testimony's object.

structural_cues: 36:65 systematically redistributes speaking and witnessing across the same ordinary human body.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mouth-sealing and bodily testimony; I infer a reversal of 36:15's confidence in verbal status assignment and its reduction of humanity to surface. The scene may adjudicate deeds generally rather than the specific liar accusation.

changed_reading.before: Ordinary human embodiment is evidence against revelation, while our mouths can judge the envoys.
changed_reading.after: Human embodiment can carry truthful testimony beyond the mouth, and the accusers' verbal verdict is not the final evidentiary authority.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final human disputant emerges from a drop, strikes an analogy, and forgets his own creation; the answer restores first origination. This diagnoses the focus's مثلنا as a comparison of finished surfaces that suppresses the generative history making a human messenger possible at all.

activation_trace.role: The finished category human is treated as familiar and self-explanatory.
Present resemblance supplies the villagers' entire analogy.
The visible human is presented as an emerged form rather than a self-grounding type.
Creative origination supplies the omitted causal history.
A small fluid origin contrasts with the finished argumentative human.
The generated human becomes an open adversary who weaponizes comparison.
The disputant actively constructs and displays an analogy.
The analogy becomes an argumentative example rather than neutral resemblance.
Omission of creation identifies the mechanism by which the analogy misleads.
The forgotten creative process is precisely the missing comparator.
Origination reopens the causal process suppressed by surface comparison.
Firstness directs attention back before the finished human form.

structural_cues: 36:77-79 explicitly sequences human emergence, open dispute, analogy, forgetting creation, and restoration of first origination.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a later human analogy diagnosed by forgotten origin; I infer that this reveals the same defect in بشر مثلنا, namely comparing surfaces while deleting generative history. The immediate topic is resurrection, so transfer to messengerhood is a formal analogy rather than identical subject matter.

changed_reading.before: Shared finished human form is sufficient evidence that no divine commissioning occurred.
changed_reading.after: The comparison is defective because it treats human form as self-explanatory and forgets the originating power that can also commission and address humans.

context_deltas.mechanism: The close makes likeness an object of creation, a thing an object of will, and قول the causal transition into being; every thing then lies within sovereignty. The focus's chain is inverted: resemblance does not block divine agency, thinghood is not empty, and speech can enact rather than fabricate.

activation_trace.role: Likeness is initially used as evidence against divine action.
Thinghood is initially emptied under unrestricted negation.
Human speech initially functions as a denying verdict.
Repeated creation language encloses both prior cosmos and prospective likeness.
Effective capacity grounds the possibility of creating the like.
A likeness is now a possible product of divine creation rather than its negation.
Authoritative command supplies the directive force of the utterance.
Will selects the thing toward which command is directed.
The knowable item denied in the focus becomes the specified object of will.
Speech becomes an effective relation between will and realized being.
Commanded and realized occurrence display the causal result of the saying.
Sovereignty encloses the total domain in which things and likenesses arise.

structural_cues: 36:81-83 closes the surah with a tightly linked sequence of creating a like, willing a thing, saying, being, and sovereignty over every thing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact recurrences of likeness, thing, saying, and occurrence under creative power; I infer a deliberate lexical inversion of 36:15's ontology. The closing sequence is cosmological and may exceed the narrower question of how revelation is mediated.

changed_reading.before: Human likeness excludes divine sending, no thing has come, and messenger speech is fabrication.
changed_reading.after: Likeness itself can be divinely produced, a thing can be willed, and speech can be causally effective; none of the villagers' three premises excludes commissioning.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from بشر as human or exposed skin to بشارة as news that opens the skin with joy. It remains anchored in the identical ب ش ر root at the focus and 36:11, where unseen relation to the Merciful leads to بشّر. Downstream prose should present it as a root-image activation, not as a claim that the two forms are syntactically interchangeable.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's بشر at word 5 is activated by the same root's بشّر at 36:11 word 9.

activation_trace.role: Exposed human surface is the level at which the envoys are dismissed.
The effective source relation is hidden from eyes rather than absent.
News from the unseen reaches and visibly opens the human surface.
The Merciful source joins unseen reception to the surface-changing news.

changed_reading.before: Being بشر fixes the envoys inside an ordinary visible category.
changed_reading.after: The human surface dismissed as a limit is also the surface that news from the unseen can open and transform.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading links بشر as visible surface with 36:37's stripping of day from night. It remains anchored in the focus's surface branch and a context branch explicitly naming removal of a skin or covering. Downstream prose should qualify it as a material analogy for epistemic surface, not a lexical derivation of بشر from سلخ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: بشر at 36:15 word 5 supplies the exposed-surface anchor for the later stripping image.

activation_trace.role: The villagers infer total reality from the visible human surface.
Removing a skin-like layer reveals that the apparent surface was contingent.

changed_reading.before: Visible human sameness is the final layer of reality.
changed_reading.after: A visible layer can be stripped away to disclose a contrary underlying condition, so human surface alone cannot settle provenance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is branch-distant because it activates the رحم or womb image inside الرحمن and combines it with carrying, a drop, and origination. It remains anchored in the packet's own رحم branch and the focus's descent construction. Downstream prose should call it a contained receptivity model, not an etymological definition of the divine name or a claim that revelation is biological.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: الرحمن and أنزل in the focus permit an exploratory model of mercy causing content to lodge, develop, and emerge through an ordinary human medium.

activation_trace.role: The womb as a protected house of growth supplies a receptive interior behind visible humanity.
Arrival and lodging supply the movement into a receptive place.
Hidden carrying keeps live the possibility of content borne within an ordinary carrier.
A minute fluid beginning demonstrates emergence through embodied process.
Origination supplies the emergence of a new realized form from the hidden process.

changed_reading.before: Ordinary human embodiment makes reception from the Merciful impossible.
changed_reading.after: Ordinary embodiment may be a protected receptive medium through which mercy lodges, develops, and becomes communicable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This material analogy is surprising because it carries the villagers' human-likeness argument into green wood producing fire. It remains anchored in بشر as judged surface and مثل as functional comparison, while 36:80 explicitly supplies the opposed material effect. Downstream prose should use it as an analogy against surface essentialism, not claim that envoys are directly symbolized by trees or fire.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus infers function from the visible surface of بشر and from resemblance; 36:80 supplies a surface whose apparent quality does not predict what it can carry or release.

activation_trace.role: Visible surface is assigned decisive evidentiary force.
Resemblance supports the rejected inference from appearance to capability.
The tree supplies the material carrier whose power is not obvious from its category.
Green living appearance creates the apparent opposition to fire.
Kindled fire is the unexpected effect borne by the green material.
Ignition realizes the latent capacity that surface classification missed.

changed_reading.before: A carrier's visible category fixes what can come through it.
changed_reading.after: A familiar surface can bear an apparently unlike effect, so ordinary human likeness does not determine the provenance or force of carried speech.

strongest_changes: The later bounded denial of a descending army corrects the focus's unrestricted no-descent claim by separating invisible commission from visible spectacle.
The loaded-vessel sequence turns likeness from a disqualifier into a property that can fit a carrier to those it carries.
The later recognition that the Merciful promised and the messengers spoke truth converts lying from an immediate status label into a relation tested by realized event.
The closing sequence makes likeness creatable, a thing willable, and saying causally effective, reversing the focus's full chain of assumptions.
The final human disputant exposes surface analogy as defective when it forgets the human's own generated origin.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence does not merely contradict the villagers. It repeatedly preserves their exact roots and argumentative shapes, then changes scope or function: no descent becomes bounded, likeness becomes carriage and creation, قول becomes promise and effective command, بشر becomes a receptive surface, and شيء moves from erased content to the object of exhaustive knowledge and will.
remaining_uncertainties: The transport, celestial-station, bodily-testimony, and green-tree mechanisms are formal analogies; the packet does not state that they directly symbolize messenger mediation.
The outer parable's مَثَل clearly frames the inner مِثْلُنَا, but the degree of intentional root-level reflexivity remains uncertain.
The womb and skin-opening activations are deliberately exploratory branch-image readings and should not be promoted to lexical definitions.
The obstruction imagery may describe a consequence of refusal rather than the causal source of the villagers' verdict.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Visible likeness is used to deny vertical mediation.** `ب ش ر` B002 is the visibly skinned human, `م ث ل` B001 likeness, and `ن ز ل` B002 bringing down. The speakers infer from horizontal bodily similarity that no descent can occur through these men. That directional arrow is theirs, not supplied by the packet; 36:79-81 later counters it by reasoning from creation to renewed creation. The ayah reads as a category error that makes visible sameness cancel unseen commissioning.
2. **Mercy is denied precisely as transmission.** `ر ح م` B001 is mercy and B003 womb; `ش ي ء` B001 is a knowable thing. The denial encloses *anything* under what the Merciful did not send, while later mercy preserves life amid danger (36:44) and speaks peace (36:58). I infer that their claim blocks mercy from taking transmissible form. This sharpens the denial from factual skepticism to refusal of mediated mercy.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 36:77-81 overturned the inference from visible human form by tracing that form to a drop and then to the creator of heaven and earth. Bodily likeness became evidence for mediation and recreation rather than against them.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Visible skin is made an illegitimate ceiling on origin.** **ب ش ر B001** supplies visible outer skin and **ب ش ر B002** the visibly skinned human in **بَشَرٌ**; **م ث ل B001** supplies counterpart likeness in **مِّثْلُنَا**. The speakers infer from visible equivalence that no **ن ز ل B002** sending-down occurred; 36:16 answers with the Lord's knowledge, and 36:20 supplies another ordinary man who confirms the messengers. The packet supplies surface likeness and the counterexample; the arrow *same visible embodiment → impossible transcendent commission* belongs to the speakers and is exposed as unsound. Their claim reads as a category error that confuses carrier surface with message source.
2. **“Nothing” erases a presented, knowable entity.** **ش ي ء B001**, specifically “knowable thing,” anchors **شَىْءٍ**, while **ك ذ ب B001** anchors terminal falsehood against truth. The messengers have already arrived and spoken (36:14), and they restate a manifest delivery in 36:16–17. The abductive relation is *denial relabels an available communicative object as non-entity*. The sweeping **مِن شَىْءٍ** thus performs erasure rather than offering a measured evidentiary judgment.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: **Later surprise.** The ordinary **رَجُلٌ** arriving in 36:20 accepts the same messengers, decisively refuting the inference that shared human embodiment blocks transcendent dispatch. Human likeness becomes the medium of confirmation as well as the objectors' reason for denial.

findings.text: Aynı insan görünümünden göksel gönderilişin imkânsızlığına varmak, taşıyıcının yüzeyini mesajın kaynağıyla karıştıran bir çıkarımdır.
“Hiçbir şey” sözü, önlerinde konuşan ve anlaşılabilir olan mesajı yok sayılan bir nesneye dönüştürür.
İtiraz, merhametin iletilebilir bir biçim almasını da peşinen reddeder.

inter_ayah_rows.note: It explicitly calls the Qur'an a sending down from the Most Merciful, Most Merciful.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: False gods' inability to avert harm does not clarify the opponents' claim that nothing was sent.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It presents the message as sent down from the Creator, supporting the possibility the focus denies.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Treating provision as denial offers only a broad parallel to rejecting a divine gift.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: Sudden punishment does not clarify the disputed basis of messengerhood.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The descent of rain is not evidence about the sending of a message.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The final helplessness of leaders and followers does not develop the focus objection.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The believer identifies alternative worship as manifest error, continuing the local counter-position.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The repeated woe to deniers adds no distinct relation to this claim.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It frames standing rightly through upholding prior and present revelation, including rejection of what is sent down.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: Hastening punishment does not clarify the denial of divine sending.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: Universal divine witness does not specifically address revelation to human messengers.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: Being misled by criminals does not explain the opponents' conclusion about the messengers.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The believer's public faith and call to listen form the local positive counterpart to refusal.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It exposes a related demand that a human messenger be visibly accompanied by an angel.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The punishment of transgressors does not add to the messengerhood objection.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: A prior decree preventing punishment does not clarify the issue of revelation.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: Angelic praise and forgiveness do not develop the denied sending of mercy.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It closely parallels the objection: a human messenger is rejected and angels are demanded instead.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The believer's entry into the Garden is downstream of the contested message.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: Intense denial of signs is too general after more specific parallels have appeared.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The messengers affirm shared humanity while explaining that God bestows favor on whom He wills.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: Persistent refusal until punishment does not clarify the human-messenger inference.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It joins fabricating lies about God with denying His signs, framing the charge exchanged in the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It explicitly pairs shared human status with received revelation, directly answering the focus claim.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The believer's forgiveness and honor do not add to the objection itself.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The labels magician and liar show a related dismissal but omit the human-messenger and sending rationale.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It shows elites treating a messenger's shared eating and drinking as grounds to reject him.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The clear authority brought to Pharaoh is a broad prophetic parallel, not a direct response.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Its description of the Qur'an as a sending from the Lord supports revelation without the human-status issue.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It rejects unsupported conjecture about divine will, loosely paralleling the focus opponents' assertion.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Questioning when the promise will come continues the local accusation that the messengers are not truthful.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: Order in the Merciful's creation does not clarify His sending of messengers.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Calling a man a fabricator of a lie about God closely parallels the focus charge against the messengers.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Mocking a known sign illustrates rejection but adds no distinct account of the focus claim.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Calling revelation merely human speech exposes the same reduction of message to its human bearer.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The statement about not being able to tempt does not develop messengerhood or revelation.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The single cry and dispute are consequences rather than clarification of the denial.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Merciful delay of punishment only broadly contextualizes the Merciful named in the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: Noah's prayer for mercy and knowledge does not clarify the objection.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Envy at God's bestowal of revelation gives a distant motive for rejecting what He sends.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Qur'anic recitation under divine witness broadly supports revelation but adds little to this objection.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: Measured retaliation does not address the contested sending of messengers.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The wish for an earlier reminder only broadly signals a need for revealed instruction.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: A merciful act in another narrative does not clarify the focus denial.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: Choosing to remember does not add to human messengerhood or divine sending.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The false promise to bear others' sins is a different form of lying without the revelation claim.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The possibility of withdrawing what was revealed confirms revelation remains under divine authority.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The prayer for a blessed landing does not clarify the sending of a message.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It states the objection almost verbatim: opponents deny that God would send a human messenger.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It explains that an angelic messenger would suit only an earthly population of angels, answering the demanded alternative.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It identifies revelation to a human being as the very cause of the rejecters' astonishment.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It explicitly describes God sending revelation through angels to human warners.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It records the charge that the messenger is merely a human like his audience, joined to dismissal of his message.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It declares that those sent before were human men who received revelation.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It makes obedience to a human like the audience into the stated reason for rejecting a messenger.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It reports the same inference that human messengers cannot guide, despite their clear proofs.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Demanding an angel to be sent exposes the same refusal to accept the existing human messenger.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The demand for an angel alongside the messenger shows the visible-proof expectation behind such rejection.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The demand for an additional sign from the Lord parallels the insufficiency claimed of the present message.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It confirms that earlier messengers ate food and walked in markets, answering the objection from ordinary humanity.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It distinguishes demanded signs from the messenger's clear warning role and locates signs with God.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It portrays opponents treating the messenger as a man seeking to turn them from inherited worship.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It exposes status-based resistance to the Qur'an being sent to a messenger outside the great towns.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It preserves the recurring pattern of calling a divine servant a liar and dismissing him as mad.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It identifies messengers as bearers of good news and warning so humanity has no argument before God.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It states that messengers were sent with clear proofs and scripture, affirming the mission the focus denies.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It describes the sending of a messenger among an unlettered people to recite, purify, and teach.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Calling the message inherited magic is a related reduction that avoids recognizing its divine source.
